subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Tell 12-hour time in hours and half hours on an analogue clock

show.line: Long hand down on six means half past. The short hand is between two and three. Half past two!

rounds.prompt: Which clock shows half past four?
rounds.praise: Yes! Long hand on six, short hand past four.

rounds.prompt: Look at the clock. What time is it? Say the time.
Where does the long hand point at half past?
rounds.praise: Yes! Down to six for half past.

rounds.prompt: Is this clock o'clock or half past? Tap the word.
Bedtime is at this time. What time is it?
One o'clock, half past one, two o'clock. What time comes next?
rounds.praise: Half past two! O'clock, half past, o'clock, half past.

hints: Long hand on six means half past.
Look where the short hand has just come from. That is the hour.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will read this clock.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: The long hand is on six. It is six o'clock!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Long hand on six means half past. It is half past three.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's look together. Long hand on six, short hand past three. Half past three!

parent_line: Can read half past times on a clock with hands.
